chapters.title: ALL HAVE GONE ASTRAY, ALL ALIKE ARE PERVERSE
AFTER A HURRICANE COMES A RAINBOW
I SHALL SING OF YOUR STRENGTH
ONE DAY YOUR KNEES WILL BEND
FALSE WORDS POUR OUT OF THEIR MOUTHS
GIVE US AID AGAINST THE FOE
SHAME THOSE WHO TRAMPLE UPON ME
FULFILL BY VOW DAY AFTER DAY
THEY SHARPEN THEIR TONGUES LIKE POISON ARROWS
YOU LED US INTO A SNARE
CAN A MERE HUMAN ALTER A PREMONITION
YOUR FOES PROUDLY RAISE THEIR HEADS
LIKE ANY MORTAL YOU SHALL DIE
DELIVER THEM FROM THE HAND OF THE WICKED
THEY SPILLED THEIR BLOOD LIKE WATER
MY SOUL CRIES OUT FOR YOU
LEST EVEN YOUR FRIENDS WILL DECEIVE
